sections.heading: Full Body Checkup Me Kya-Kya Hota Hai — Aur Ye Kis Ke Liye Hai
sections.lead: Seedha jawab pehle, phir wo baat jo naam nahi batata: "full body" me poora sharir nahi aata.
blocks: Ek aam full body checkup me ye aate hain — CBC (khoon ki ginti), blood sugar, HbA1c, lipid profile (cholesterol), liver function test, kidney function test, thyroid aur urine routine. Bade package me Vitamin D aur Vitamin B12 bhi jud jaate hain. Ye saare test ek hi baar nas se liye gaye khoon aur ek urine sample par ho jaate hain, ek tay daam par, aur report aam taur par agle din phone par PDF me aa jaati hai.

Package ka kaam un cheezon ko jaldi pakadna hai jo chup chaap badh rahi hoti hain — sugar, cholesterol, thyroid, liver, kidney aur vitamin ki kami. Inme se koi bhi shuruaat me kuch mehsoos nahi karati. Jab tak mehsoos hota hai, tab tak kai saal nikal chuke hote hain. Yahi package ka poora point hai, aur yahi wajah hai ki ye un logon ke liye hai jinhe abhi koi shikayat nahi hai.

Ab wo baat jo naam nahi batata, aur jo sabse zyada galat samjhi jaati hai. Package ho jaane ke baad “ab sab theek hai” maan lena hi is jaanch ka sabse bada nuksan hai. Ismein cancer ki screening nahi hoti, dil ki bimari ka pakka pata nahi chalta, haddi aur jodon ki jaanch nahi hoti, aur jo cheezein machine par dikhti hain — X-ray, ECG, ultrasound — wo ismein aati hi nahi. Ye teenon machine par hote hain, sample par nahi, isliye hamare menu me bhi nahi hain.
Isliye seedha niyam: koi shikayat pehle se hai to package mat chuniye — doctor ko dikhaiye aur wahi test karaiye jo wo kahe. Package un logon ke liye hai jinhe abhi kuch nahi hai.

sections.lead: Sheher me package ke vikalp bahut hain. Unhe tolne ka ek hi tareeka kaam karta hai, aur usme do minute lagte hain.
blocks: Tareeka ye hai: dono package ki test soochi maangiye — parameter ki ginti nahi, TEST ke naam — aur neeche wali table ke saamne rakh kar tick lagaiye. Jis package me upar ki paanch line poori hain, wo aage hai; jisme thyroid aur vitamin bhi hain, wo usse aage. Ye do minute ka kaam saal bhar ka farak daal deta hai, kyunki jo test chhoot gaya uska pata agle saal chalta hai — aur tab tak wo saal ja chuka hota hai.

sections.heading: Gorakhpur Me Full Body Checkup Kitne Ka Hota Hai — Daam Kis Baat Par Tay Hota Hai
sections.lead: Sasta aur mehnga me farak ginti ka nahi, shaamil test ka hota hai — aur aaj ka rate ek hi jagah likha rehta hai.
blocks: Is sheher me package ke vikalp bahut hain, aur daam me kaafi farak dikhta hai. Wo farak teen cheezon se aata hai: package me kaunse test hain, unme se kitne mehnge test hain, aur kya usme vitamin jaise test bhi hain. Vitamin D aur B12 alag reagent aur alag machine maangte hain, isliye jis package me ye dono hain uska daam upar rahega — aur us badhe hue daam ke badle asli jaankari mil rahi hoti hai, sirf ek lambi list nahi.

list: Do package ka daam milaate waqt sirf number mat dekhiye — dono ki list saamne rakhiye aur upar wali saat cheezein tick kijiye. Jo package inke bina sasta pad raha hai, wo isliye sasta hai ki usme kam hai — kam daam me zyada nahi mil raha, kam mil raha hai.
Package me bachat sabse zyada hoti hai. Wahi test alag-alag karane par kharcha kai guna ho jaata hai — yahi package ka poora point hai.
Ghar se sample lene ka koi alag charge is daam ke upar nahi jodha jaata. Package ka jo daam likha hai wahi dena hota hai — na visiting charge, na travel charge.
Payment sample lene ke waqt hota hai, cash ya UPI se. Pehle se paisa dene ki zaroorat nahi.
Report par reference range aur method chhapega ya nahi — ye poochhiye. Sabse sasti report agar padhi hi na ja sake to wo sasti nahi, bekaar hai.

Kuch test us waqt ki zaroorat par tay hote hain aur unke card par 'Call for price' likha rehta hai — unka daam sample dene se pehle bata diya jaata hai, baad me nahi.

note.text: Jo cheez package se chhoot gayi, uska pata agle saal chalta hai — aur tab tak wo ek saal aage badh chuki hoti hai. Daam ki tulna tabhi matlab rakhti hai jab dono package me shaamil test lagbhag ek jaise hon. Isliye pehle list milaiye, phir daam.

sections.heading: Full Body Checkup Khaali Pet Kyun Hota Hai — Lipid Profile Ki Wajah
sections.lead: Package me sirf yahi test fasting maangta hai. Isliye slot ka poora hisaab isi par tikka hai.
blocks: Lipid Profile me cholesterol aur triglyceride ke chaar-paanch number aate hain — Total Cholesterol, LDL, HDL aur Triglycerides. Ye dil ki bimari ka sabse jaldi milne wala ishaara hai, aur wo ishaara aksar der se pakda jaata hai kyunki koi lakshan hota hi nahi.

list: Isi ek test ke liye 10 se 12 ghante khaali pet rehna padta hai. Baaki poora package isi ek shart ke peechhe chalta hai. HbA1c, TSH, CBC, LFT, Vitamin D aur B12 me fasting lagti hi nahi.

Triglycerides wo hissa hai jo khaane ke baad sabse tezi se badalta hai, aur isi wajah se poori report bhatka deta hai. Ek din pehle bahut tala-bhuna khaya ho to number badha hua aa sakta hai — ek din pehle aam khana khaiye, na zyada parhez, na daawat.
Ek din pehle sharaab bilkul nahi. Triglycerides is par seedha badh jaate hain aur report ka matlab bigad jaata hai.
LDL ko “kharaab” aur HDL ko “achha” keh dena aasan hai, par usse aadhi baat hi samajh me aati hai. Doctor teenon ko saath me, aur sugar tatha BP ke saath milakar dekhta hai.
Sugar ki dawa chal rahi hai to lipid saal me ek baar zaroor — ye wahi test hai jo follow-up me sabse zyada chhoota hai.

blocks: Isliye package ke liye subah 6 se 8 ka pehla slot lijiye: khaali pet ka waqt sabse kam rehta hai aur naashta sample ke turant baad ho jaata hai.

sections.heading: LFT Aur KFT Package Me Aate Hain Ya Alag Se Karane Padte Hain
sections.lead: Dono package me aa jaate hain. Alag se karane ka apna waqt hai, aur wo alag hai.
blocks: LFT aur KFT do chup rehne wale ang ki jaanch hain. Liver aur kidney dono ki khaasiyat yahi hai ki wo kaafi door tak bina shikayat ke kaam karte rehte hain — jab tak lakshan dikhte hain, kaafi hissa peeche chhoot chuka hota hai. Isiliye ye dono har dhang ke package me hone chahiye.

list: LFT me kya aata hai — Bilirubin (total aur direct), SGOT/AST, SGPT/ALT, Alkaline Phosphatase, aur protein tatha albumin. Peeliya, fatty liver aur dawa ka asar — teenon yahin dikhte hain.
KFT me kya aata hai — Urea, Creatinine, Uric Acid aur electrolytes. Iske saath urine routine hona chahiye, warna aadhi tasveer hi milti hai.
LFT me aam taur par fasting nahi lagti. Package me aa raha hai to package ke niyam chalenge (yaani khaali pet, lipid ki wajah se).
KFT me bhi aam taur par fasting nahi lagti. Sample se pehle paani peete rahiye — paani ki kami me urea aur creatinine jhoothe taur par badhe hue aate hain.
Daam ke liye rate list dekhiye — LFT aur KFT dono ka rate service page par likha hai, aur package me lene par alag-alag karane se kaafi kam padta hai.

blocks: Alag se kab karaiye, ye tay karna aasan hai. Barsaat ke baad peeliya ke maamle is ilaake me badhte hain — aankhon ya peshab ka rang peela dikhe, bhookh mar jaaye, ya lagatar kamzori rahe to LFT alag se, doctor ke kehne par. Aur sugar ya BP ki dawa chal rahi ho to KFT saal me ek baar, urine microalbumin ke saath — microalbumin wahi test hai jo sabse pehle ishaara deta hai ki kidney par asar shuru ho raha hai, us waqt jab creatinine ab bhi normal dikhta hai. Yahi test package me aksar nahi hota aur sabse zyada chhoota hai.

Ek baat test se pehle bata dene wali: jo dawa chal rahi hai — dard ki goli, antibiotic, ayurvedic ya bina label wale nuskhe, aur sharaab — ye sab LFT aur KFT dono ke number par asar daal sakte hain. Booking ke waqt bata dijiye. In dono par vistaar se
; wo Deoria ke naam se hai, lekin jaanch ki baat har jagah wahi hai.

sections.heading: Senior Citizen Health Package Gorakhpur — 55 Ke Upar Kya Jodein
sections.lead: Is umar me package ka kaam badal jaata hai — screening se follow-up ki taraf.
blocks: 55 ke upar package chunne ka tareeka alag hai. Is umar me sirf "kuch chhupa hua hai kya" nahi dekha jaata; ye bhi dekha jaata hai ki jo pehle se chal raha hai wo kis disha me ja raha hai. Isliye senior citizen package me kuch cheezein zaroori ho jaati hain jo kam umar me optional thi.

list: HbA1c — sirf fasting sugar kaafi nahi. Is umar me sugar ka teen mahine ka ausat zyada kaam ka hota hai.
KFT ke saath urine routine — kidney par asar sabse chup chaap shuru hota hai, aur umar ke saath ye risk badhta hai.
Lipid Profile — dil ke liye. Ye is umar me har saal hona chahiye, chahe pichhli baar normal aaya ho.
Thyroid — bujurgon me thyroid ke lakshan aksar "umar ka asar" maan liye jaate hain: thakan, wazan, thand, sust rehna.
Vitamin D — haddi aur girne ke khatre se seedha juda hua. Ghar ke andar rehne wale bujurgon me kami aam hai.
Vitamin B12 — jhunjhuni, sunnpan aur yaadasht ki shikayat me ise dekha jaata hai.

blocks: Do cheezein jo package me nahi aatin aur is umar me zaroori hain: aankh ki jaanch aur pair ki jaanch (khaas kar sugar wale mareezon me). Ye doctor ke paas hoti hain, lab me nahi — inhe lab test se mat badaliye. Isi tarah BP ki naapti ghar par hoti rehni chahiye; wo package ka hissa nahi hai.

Bujurgon ke liye ghar par sample lene ka faayda sabse zyada hai — nikalna hi sabse mushkil hissa hota hai. Booking me mareez ki haalat likh dijiye: bistar par hain, nas patli hai, ya khoon patla karne wali dawa chal rahi hai.

sections.lead: Pehla package ek photo hai. Doosra package se disha milti hai, aur disha hi kaam ki cheez hai.
blocks: Package ki report lambi hoti hai aur usme kuch na kuch laal zaroor dikhta hai. Isliye padhne ka ek kram hona chahiye — aur uska sabse zaroori hissa pichhle saal ki report hai.

list: Pehle header — naam, umar, gender. Reference range inhi par badalti hai.
Uske baad wo paanch hisse jinke liye package karaya hi jaata hai: sugar, lipid, liver, kidney aur khoon ki ginti.
Har number ke bagal me us lab ki apni reference range dekhiye. Doosri lab ki range se mat milaiye.
Ab pichhle saal ki report kholiye aur wahi paanch cheezein milaiye. Number normal range me hai lekin har saal upar badh raha hai — ye baat ek saal ki report kabhi nahi bata sakti.
Ek-do point ka upar-neeche hona apne aap me kisi bimari ka matlab nahi rakhta. Doctor pattern dekhta hai, ek number nahi.
Vitamin ki kami nikli ho to apne mann se high-dose goli shuru mat kijiye — khuraak kami ki gehrai par tay hoti hai.

blocks: Isi wajah se do baatein maayne rakhti hain. Pehli — har baar lagbhag usi mahine me karaiye, taaki tulna seedhi rahe. Doosri — ek hi lab par tike rahiye, kyunki do alag analyser ke number ka farak sehat ka farak nahi hota. Gorakhpur me ye galti isliye zyada hoti hai ki vikalp bahut hain aur har baar jahan sahulat ho wahin karwa liya jaata hai.

note.title: "Sab normal hai" ka matlab "sab theek hai" nahi hota

Isliye koi nayi shikayat shuru ho to use ye keh kar mat taaliye ki pichhle mahine hi to poora checkup hua tha.

faqs.question: Gorakhpur me full body checkup kitne ka hota hai?
faqs.answer: Daam is baat par tay hota hai ki package me kaunse test hain — kitne “parameter” likhe hain us par nahi. Jis package me HbA1c, thyroid, Vitamin D aur B12 shaamil hain wo upar padega, aur us badhe hue daam ke badle asli jaankari milti hai; jo package inke bina sasta hai wo isliye sasta hai ki usme kam hai. Ghar se sample lene ka koi alag charge daam ke upar nahi jodha jaata. Aaj ka rate har package ke saamne Gorakhpur ki rate list par likha rehta hai, aur booking confirm karne wali call par poora amount sample lene se pehle bata diya jaata hai.

faqs.question: Full body checkup ke liye khaali pet rehna zaroori hai?
faqs.answer: Haan, aur wajah aam taur par sirf ek test hoti hai — lipid profile, jiske liye 10 se 12 ghante khaali pet rehna padta hai (fasting sugar bhi package me ho to wo bhi). HbA1c, TSH, CBC, LFT, Vitamin D aur B12 ke liye fasting lagti hi nahi, isliye unke naam par bhookha rehna bekaar hai. Sabse aasan tareeka ye hai: raat ka khana 9 baje tak khatam kar lijiye, subah 6 se 8 wala pehla slot lijiye, beech me sirf saada paani, aur naashta pehle se taiyaar rakhiye taaki sample ke turant baad kha sakein.

faqs.question: LFT aur KFT package me aate hain ya alag se karane padte hain?
faqs.answer: Dhang ke har package me dono aate hain, aur package me lene par alag-alag karane se kaafi kam padta hai. Alag se tab karaiye jab koi shikayat ho — jaise peeliya ke lakshan me LFT — ya sugar aur BP ki dawa chal rahi ho, jahan KFT saal me ek baar urine microalbumin ke saath hona chahiye. Microalbumin package me aksar nahi hota aur sabse zyada chhoota hai.

faqs.question: Senior citizen package me aisa kya hota hai jo normal package me nahi?
faqs.answer: 55 ke upar package ka kaam screening se follow-up ki taraf badal jaata hai. Isliye HbA1c, KFT ke saath urine routine, lipid, thyroid aur Vitamin D — ye sab zaroori ho jaate hain, jo kam umar me optional the. Do cheezein package me nahi aatin aur is umar me zaroori hain: aankh ki jaanch aur pair ki jaanch. Wo doctor ke paas hoti hain, lab me nahi.

faqs.question: Zyada parameter wala package hamesha behtar hota hai?
faqs.answer: Nahi, aur is sheher me yahi galti sabse mehngi padti hai kyunki vikalp bahut hain. Akela CBC hi report par 18 se 22 line chhapta hai — yaani ginti badhana aasan hai aur uska matlab kuch nahi. Do package tolne ka tareeka ye hai: dono ki TEST soochi saamne rakhiye aur dekhiye ki CBC, sugar, lipid, LFT, KFT, thyroid aur vitamin me se kaun kaun sa hai. Jisme upar ki paanch line poori hain wo aage hai, chahe uska parameter number chhota dikhe.

faqs.question: OPD dikhani hai — package pehle karwa lein ya doctor ko pehle dikhayein?
faqs.answer: Koi nayi shikayat hai to doctor pehle — package aapki shikayat ka jawab nahi deta aur wo kuch aur test likh sakta hai. Sirf saalana checkup hai to package seedhe karwa lijiye, doctor ki parchi ki zaroorat nahi. Follow-up hai to jo test pichhli baar hue the wahi dohraiye, OPD se ek din pehle — report agli subah PDF me haath me hogi.

faqs.question: Package saal me kitni baar karana chahiye?
faqs.answer: Umar 30 se kam hai aur koi shikayat nahi to do saal me ek baar kaafi hai; 30 ke upar saal me ek baar. Har baar lagbhag usi mahine me karaiye, taaki do saal ki report seedhe aamne-saamne tuli ja sakein — yahi is jaanch ki sabse kaam ki cheez hai. Do mahine me dobara karane ka koi faayda nahi, kyunki ye number itni jaldi badalte hi nahi. Sugar, BP ya thyroid ki dawa chal rahi hai to uska follow-up alag chalta hai aur uski apni tareekhein hoti hain — use package se mat badaliye.

faqs.question: Ghar ke chaar log ek saath full body checkup kara sakte hain?
faqs.answer: Haan, aur ghar me ye sabse aasan tareeka hai. Sab logon ki booking ek hi slot me karwa dijiye — ek hi visit me sabka sample le liya jaata hai. Booking ke waqt har vyakti ka naam, umar aur uska package alag alag likhwaiye, warna report milaane me uljhan hoti hai. Jinke package me fasting wala test nahi hai unhe subah bhookha rakhne ki zaroorat nahi. Report har vyakti ki apni alag PDF me aati hai, saath me nahi.

faqs.question: Full body checkup me kaun se test hote hain?
faqs.answer: Ek aam package me CBC, fasting blood sugar, HbA1c, lipid profile, LFT (liver), KFT (kidney), thyroid (TSH) aur urine routine aate hain; advanced package me Vitamin D, Vitamin B12 aur iron bhi jud jaate hain. Har lab ka package bilkul yahi list de, ye zaroori nahi — isliye booking se pehle test ki soochi maangiye aur usme paanch hisse dhoondhiye: khoon, sugar, dil (lipid), liver aur kidney. In paanch me se koi ek bhi na ho to package adhoora hai, chahe usme parameter kitne bhi likhe hon.

faqs.question: Full body checkup me kitna time lagta hai?
faqs.answer: Sample dene me 10 se 15 minute. Poora package ek hi baar nas se liye gaye khoon par hota hai, isliye har test ke liye alag sui nahi lagti; urine sample ka container saath me chhod diya jaata hai. Ghar par sample lene ki booking me confirmation call lagbhag 30 minute me aa jaati hai. Is jaanch me aapka poora din kahin nahi jaata: planning sirf fasting ke 10 se 12 ghante maangte hain, aur wo ghante raat ki neend me hi nikal jaate hain.

faqs.question: Full body checkup ki report kitne ghante me aa jaati hai?
faqs.answer: Zyadatar package ki report 24 ghante ke andar PDF me phone par aa jaati hai — CBC, sugar, HbA1c, lipid, LFT, KFT, thyroid aur urine routine sab isi me. Vitamin D aur B12 bhi aam taur par usi samay me aa jaate hain. Sirf urine culture alag hai; usme 48 se 72 ghante lagte hain, kyunki culture ko badhne ka samay dena padta hai. Report phone par milti hai, isliye OPD me dikhane ke liye print le kar chalna zaroori nahi.

faqs.question: Full body checkup me kitne parameter hone chahiye?
faqs.answer: Parameter ki ginti sabse kam kaam ki jaankari hai. Akela CBC hi report par 18 se 22 line chhapta hai aur urine routine 10 se 15 — dono mila kar hi 30 se zyada "parameter" ban jaate hain. Isliye 80 parameter wala package 45 parameter wale se kamzor ho sakta hai, agar usme thyroid ya HbA1c hai hi nahi. Ginti ke bajaye TEST ki list dekhiye, aur usme paanch system poore hain ya nahi ye dekhiye.

faqs.question: Gorakhpur me full body checkup ghar se sample de kar ho sakta hai?
faqs.answer: Haan — package ka har test sample par hota hai, isliye poora package ghar par ho jaata hai. Home collection free hai aur phlebotomist ID card ke saath aata hai. Slot subah 6 baje se shuru hote hain, jo fasting wale package ke liye sabse aasan padta hai. Payment sample lene ke waqt cash ya UPI se hota hai. Ek baat dhyaan me rakhiye: X-ray, ECG aur ultrasound is package me nahi aate — wo machine par hote hain, sample par nahi. Parche par unme se kuch likha ho to uske liye imaging centre alag se jaana hoga, aur wo trip package se bachti nahi.
